name: Deep Peroneal Neuropathy / Anterior Tarsal Tunnel Syndrome
tags: deep peroneal neuropathy / anterior tarsal tunnel syndrome
definition: Compression of the deep peroneal nerve at the anterior ankle, producing first-web-space sensory symptoms and sometimes extensor weakness.

investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent entrapment with deficit may require decompression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Compression of the deep peroneal nerve at the anterior ankle, producing first-web-space sensory symptoms and sometimes extensor weakness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
